notes: Updates are easier: the app tells you by itself when a new version is ready, even when it's closed, and shows a progress bar while it installs. After updating, a short "What's new" note appears.
Cleaning is smoother: deleting junk or duplicate photos now shows its progress instead of freezing, and tells you how much space you freed.

Holiday greetings: on public holidays like Mashujaa Day, Jamhuri Day, Christmas and New Year, ScottPrivacy greets you with a special poster and a short celebration of flowers and emojis. Share the greeting with friends and family in one tap.
Holiday notifications: get one greeting notification with the poster on the morning of the holiday. You can turn these off under "Holiday greetings" in your phone's notification settings.
